# JoyLab Cluster Update Checklist V1

Use this checklist for every REFRESH / EXPAND / COMPARE / PILLAR maintenance task.

## A. Task Classification

- [ ] REFRESH
- [ ] EXPAND
- [ ] COMPARE
- [ ] PILLAR

Cluster:

Target URL / slug:

Reason for update:

Material event / date:

## B. Source Check

### Investment / Company
- [ ] DART / KRX checked
- [ ] Latest company IR / earnings checked
- [ ] Official order / CAPEX / capital policy checked
- [ ] Valuation reference date stated

### AI / Productivity
- [ ] Official product docs checked
- [ ] Governance / admin / security docs checked
- [ ] Release notes or latest official announcement checked

### Growth / Leadership
- [ ] Operating criterion is explicit
- [ ] Evidence or actual case is stated
- [ ] Outcome vs leading indicator is separated

## C. Editorial Check

- [ ] What changed is clear
- [ ] Fact and Interpretation are separated
- [ ] Existing thesis changed / unchanged is stated
- [ ] Scenario conditions are explicit
- [ ] Action / next check condition remains
- [ ] Internal links connect to previous / next Research

## D. Template Check

- [ ] Correct official template selected
- [ ] Same Lens applied symmetrically for comparison
- [ ] No unnecessary new component/template introduced

## E. V2 Design Gold Gate

- [ ] V2 Design System followed
- [ ] Existing Gold component grammar reused
- [ ] PC layout checked
- [ ] 390px mobile checked
- [ ] Long title / company name wraps safely
- [ ] No horizontal overflow
- [ ] Table is readable and horizontally scrollable on mobile if needed
- [ ] START HERE / Related Research route to correct Pillar

## F. Platform Gate

- [ ] Existing slug preserved unless migration is intentional
- [ ] canonical preserved
- [ ] sitemap / RSS behavior preserved
- [ ] dependency audit success
- [ ] Astro build success
- [ ] PR CI success
- [ ] main merge success
- [ ] Cloudflare deploy success
- [ ] custom domain success
- [ ] production smoke success
